preservedSemantics: Off-main matching-name delivery only increments the existing locked fault counter, before any projection.
The exact actual notification object remains strongly held through the synchronous actor closure with withExtendedLifetime; its address cannot be recycled during filtering/capture.
Only optional String identity, existing Sendable kind and weak actor observer cross into MainActor.assumeIsolated; no Notification or AnyObject crosses.
Inside the actor, app/window/current-scene selection preserves the existing three-family exact identity test, rejects nil or foreign identities and reads only the owned window current scene.
Accepted snapshots pass the equal owned actual object to the unchanged capture method, preserving the emitted object identity; app/window remain held only during synchronous processing.
The current scene is still read once for filtering and again during the existing sequential snapshot.
No actor queue, Task, timer, new notification, activation, focus request, input, unsafe isolation annotation or broad unchecked Sendable conformance is added.
The Foundation data helper, source closure other members, budgets, original oracle and result remain unchanged by the proposed patch.
requiredBeforeAcceptance: Producer must select and implement any correction in its own lane and reseal exact source/archive bindings.
Executable tests must verify all fourteen kinds, nil/foreign object filtering, owned current-scene changes, lifetime preservation, weak ownership, off-main fault handling and capacity.
Independent source and finite host review remains required for the correction.
Root must separately select one fresh complete UIKit generic build against corrected source; this proposal has not been typechecked.
Any native attempt requires separate root selection after its own prerequisites.
summary: Project the notification object into an optional Sendable String identity before the synchronous MainActor boundary; preserve actual-object lifetime and compare only with currently owned objects inside the actor.
why: Swift 6 rejects capturing non-Sendable task-isolated Notification in MainActor.assumeIsolated.
